title: Imagen 4 model card update
description: Google DeepMind updated Imagen 4 with improved prompt fidelity and a new Imagen 4 Ultra preset focused on photoreal portraits and editorial-grade composition.

title: Veo 3 in Vertex AI
description: Google DeepMind shipped Veo 3 to Vertex AI with longer video clips, improved camera control, and a Veo Caption helper for storyboard-style prompts.

title: Gemini 2.2 announced
description: Google announced Gemini 2.2 with improved agentic planning and multimodal performance, plus a Gemini 2.2 Flash variant tuned for low-latency agent loops.

title: Genie 3 interactive world preview
description: Google DeepMind unveiled Genie 3 in research preview, a foundation model that turns text or images into navigable, interactive 3D worlds for embodied research and game prototyping.

title: Gemini 2.2 Pro on AI Studio and Vertex AI
description: Gemini 2.2 Pro reached general availability on AI Studio and Vertex AI with a 2M-token context window and stronger long-document and tool-use benchmarks.

title: Gemini Deep Think GA
description: Gemini Deep Think mode reached general availability for Gemini Advanced subscribers, exposing parallel reasoning paths and tool routing for complex research and coding tasks.

title: AlphaFold Server 3 update
description: AlphaFold Server 3 added support for ligand-protein, nucleic acid, and antibody-complex predictions in the public research portal, with higher-throughput batched submissions.

title: AI Studio workflow upgrades
description: Google AI Studio added reusable workflow templates and evaluation runs for Gemini applications, including JSON schema-aware test fixtures.

title: GraphCast 2 weather model
description: Google DeepMind published GraphCast 2 with stronger 14-day medium-range forecasts and a partnership with the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts for operational evaluation.

title: Gemini 3.0 Flash preview
description: Google DeepMind opened a Gemini 3.0 Flash developer preview on AI Studio with a 1M-token context window, native multimodal output, and a price drop versus 2.2 Flash.

title: Veo 3.1 with synchronized audio
description: Veo 3.1 in Vertex AI added synchronized audio generation, longer 16s clips, and a reference-image conditioning mode for character consistency across cuts.

title: Gemini CLI 1.0 GA
description: Google released Gemini CLI 1.0 to general availability with model selection, prompt caching, MCP server hosting, and a /tool command for sandboxed tool execution.

title: Gemini 3.0 Pro experimental
description: Google DeepMind opened experimental access to Gemini 3.0 Pro on AI Studio with sustained 2M-token context, stronger SWE-bench Verified scores, and a new computer-use tool surface.

title: Imagen 4 Ultra reaches GA in Vertex AI
description: Imagen 4 Ultra reached general availability in Vertex AI with safety classifier improvements, a watermarking SynthID tag enabled by default, and per-region inference.

title: Gemini API data residency in the EU and UK
description: Gemini API added EU and UK data residency options for regulated workloads, with regionally pinned inference, prompt logging controls, and Workspace-level audit exports.

title: Gemma 3 family release
description: Google released Gemma 3 checkpoints in 1B, 4B, 12B, and 27B sizes with improved instruction tuning, multilingual quality, and a 128k context window across the lineup.

title: Gemma 3 multimodal checkpoints
description: Google followed the text-only Gemma 3 release with Gemma 3 Multimodal (4B and 12B), supporting interleaved image+text reasoning under the standard Gemma terms-of-use.

title: Gemini 3.0 Pro general availability
description: Gemini 3.0 Pro reached general availability across Gemini API, Vertex AI, and Gemini Advanced with stable pricing, signed model SHAs, and a documented agentic tool surface.

title: Genie 3 research access program
description: Google DeepMind opened a controlled research access program for Genie 3 with 25 academic and industry partners across robotics, simulation, and game-design research.

title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 model card published
description: Google DeepMind published the Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 model card for an embodied-reasoning vision-language model based on Gemini 3.0 Flash, with up to 128k context over text, image, audio, and video inputs.

title: Google Cloud Next 26
description: Google Cloud Next 26 showcased Google Cloud AI announcements, including Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, agentic data cloud updates, and new TPU infrastructure.

title: Gemini enterprise controls expanded
description: Google expanded admin controls, data handling policy options, and deployment governance for Gemini enterprise usage, including per-app context grounding scopes in Workspace.

title: Trillium v2 (TPU v6e+) GA
description: Google Cloud announced general availability of Trillium v2, the second generation of its TPU v6e generation, with higher peak compute and improved energy efficiency for Gemini and customer workloads.

title: Gemini Deep Research Pro GA
description: Gemini Deep Research Pro reached GA in the Gemini app and Workspace with longer multi-source research runs, citation snapshots, and shareable research workspaces with team controls.

title: Gemma 4 highlighted by Google DeepMind
description: Google DeepMind highlighted Gemma 4 as its latest open-model family on the official news page, positioning it as a byte-efficient generation of Gemma models.

title: Vertex AI Agent Builder v2
description: Google Cloud released Vertex AI Agent Builder v2 with multi-agent orchestration, A2A handoffs, MCP server hosting, and traceable evals tied to BigQuery datasets.

title: Gemini 3.0 Flash GA + price update
description: Gemini 3.0 Flash reached GA on Gemini API and Vertex AI with a 25% price cut on cached input tokens, plus a new low-latency "Flash-Lite 3" preview tier for high-throughput automation.

title: Gemini Nano 3 on Android via AICore
description: Google released Gemini Nano 3 to Android AICore on Pixel 9, Pixel 10, and supported Samsung devices, with on-device function calling, multimodal understanding, and a Speak Assist accessibility surface.

title: Google I/O 2026 day 1
description: Google I/O 2026 opens online May 19 with the Google keynote at 10:00am PT and the Developer keynote at 1:30pm PT, with Gemini and Android expected as headline developer topics.

title: Google I/O 2026 day 2
description: Second day of Google I/O 2026 livestreamed sessions and developer content, continuing the May 19-20 program for Gemini, Android, web, and cloud developers.
